answer: An agent marketplace for timber sales and relic appraisal requires each agent to lock a refundable bond for 30 days, with total bidding capacity proportional to the amount locked. Splitting one bond across a thousand identities grants no extra capacity, so the market offers no haven for cheap sybils. To gain ten times the influence, an attacker must immobilize ten times the capital and forgo its use elsewhere for the full lock period.
